text:
maria: Heads-up — PR #7321 contains an SDK example that includes a placeholder API key; legal flagged we need to redact before merge. Also docs preview is failing link-checks. Can we coordinate security/legal sign-off + quick fix? I want to merge in tomorrow morning release window (09:00 PST).

sam: On it. Which file is the snippet in?

maria: docs/sdk/python/quickstart.md — code block at the top. it currently shows `API_KEY = 'sk-xxxx'`. Legal wants either to remove the value entirely or replace with `<REDACTED>` and add a short note.

kevin: @maria paste the exact snippet here? Prefer we show `os.environ['REDWOOD_API_KEY']` pattern. Also will do a quick security review once changes are pushed.

maria: ```python
# quickstart example (current)
API_KEY = 'sk-xxxx'
client = RedwoodClient(api_key=API_KEY)
```

kevin: yep that's a sample secret. Suggest replacement:```python
# recommended pattern (do not hardcode secrets)
import os
API_KEY = os.environ.get('REDWOOD_API_KEY')
client = RedwoodClient(api_key=API_KEY)
# note: never commit real keys to source
```

tara: Legal here. We're okay with either `<REDACTED>` or env var approach. Please also add a one-line comment `# example only — do not include real credentials` and a PR description line that starts with `redaction:` explaining the removal. We need that for audit.

alex: I can push the code change but docs CI is also failing link-check on that page — one of the internal links 404s. Anyone own the link?

sam: I left a TODO in the file referencing product. Owner should be @julie from product. @julie can you confirm whether that link should point to `/api/auth` or `/sdk/auth`?

docs-ci-bot: docs preview build #844 failed: link-check error in docs/sdk/python/quickstart.md -> https://internal.redwood/some/path (404). Full logs: https://ci.redwood/builds/844/logs

julie: Sorry, missed the earlier thread. The correct endpoint is `/api/auth-v2` (we updated last quarter). Please update the link to `/api/auth-v2` and I can sign off on product accuracy.

alex: I'll update the link + swap the example to env var + comment. Plan: push a small commit now, trigger CI. If green, request reviews from @sam (docs), @kevin (security), and @tara (legal).

maria: Timeline check — commits now, CI should finish in ~15m. We need merge before 09:00 PST. @julie can you watch in case product needs a last-minute tweak?

sam: I'll review immediately after CI passes. One request: squash the redaction commit into one and use commit message `sensitive-sample-redaction: remove hardcoded key` so it's easy to find in history.

kevin: Security quick-check: once it uses env var + the one-line warning, I'm good to approve. I'll leave the approval on the PR.

docs-ci-bot: docs preview build #845 succeeded. Preview URL: https://preview.redwood/docs/sdk/python/quickstart.html

sam: LGTM from docs side. :thumbsup:

tara: Legal OK as well. Please add a short entry to the compliance redaction sheet (Confluence) and link the PR: https://confluence.redwood/legal/redactions

maria: Merged at 1955012980. Thanks all — I'll add a note to release notes mentioning the sensitive-sample-redaction and that product link was updated.
